clauses.reason: Terminated by its own terms. The operative sentence exempts Edward D. Anderson from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year and fixes the last day: "one year ending September 30, 1942". The end is recorded as 1942-09-30, inclusive (the exemption runs through that day, per the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on stated end dates); the exclusive reading, under which the exemption ends when that day begins, is the alternative a reviewer should see. The recital explains why the exemption is wanted and adds no separate command. No earlier exemption is recited. The packet's searches (number citations, Federal Register catalog notes, person-name search) show no later order that changes the period or ends the exemption earlier; see the order-level checks.

savings.reason: Service performed and pay earned while the exemption ran are accrued effects of the order; any annuity or retirement-credit consequence flows from the retirement statutes, not from this order, and does not keep the order operative: the order commands nothing after its stated last day (type rule TR-RETIREMENT-EXEMPTION, exceptions_savings: state transferred_or_accrued). No held later instrument is shown to keep this exemption operative.
